stem:
Qadir observes an Amoeba under a microscope. It is a single cell. He also sketches a neem seedling made of many cells.

Which claim about living organisms is correct?

options.text: A unicellular organism like Amoeba is not made of cells.
All living organisms are made of cells, whether they have one cell or many cells.
Only plants are made of cells; single-celled organisms are not.
Every microscopic organism consists of exactly one cell.

teacher.key_rationale: Living organisms are built from cells whether they have one cell or many. Amoeba is still a cell; not every microscopic organism is unicellular.
